content:
Today Apple released a variety of software updates with the latest security fixes, including iOS 26.7.3 for iPhone, watchOS 27.2.1 for Apple Watch, and more.

New security-focused updates arrive for most Apple platforms, including older versions of iOS, macOS, more

Most Apple devices have new software updates available to install today. That’s because Apple has rolled out a wide array of minor updates aimed at patching security vulnerabilities and eliminating bugs.

Joining iOS 27.2.1 and iPadOS 27.2.1, Apple has released security-focused updates for iPhone and iPad users not yet running version 27 software. They include:

  • iOS 26.7.3
  • iPadOS 26.7.3
  • iOS 18.7.12
  • iPadOS 18.7.12

Additionally, watchOS 27.2.1 and watchOS 26.6.1 are now available for Apple Watch users.

Vision Pro users have visionOS 27.2.1 available to install. And the Mac has received several updates too, including macOS 27.2.1 and updates to macOS 26 and macOS 15.

The only platforms without updates are tvOS and HomePod software. Those may ship later this week though ahead of the new Apple TV 4K.

Apple will publish the security details on these updates on this webpage soon.
